title: The First Day
vision: The bus turns onto the bridge.
wake: You open your eyes. You are at the bus stop. The bus is just pulling in.

bus.text: “Getting on or not?” You just watched this bus fall off the bridge. It hasn't happened yet.

left.label: Warn everyone
left.after: Most of them laugh. A girl in a yellow coat gets off and walks over: Elif.

right.label: Walk away quietly
right.after: The doors close. The bus turns the corner.

sirens.text: Sirens from the direction of the bridge. Your hands are shaking.

left.label: Put your earbuds in
left.after: The sirens fade. Everything feels a little further away.

right.label: Check the news
right.after: The bridge on your screen. The bus in the water. You pocket your earbuds.

cafe.text: Your hand shakes and coffee spills onto your shoe. The waiter wipes the floor.

left.label: Sit until it dries
left.after: Five minutes in the chair. Your breathing slows.

right.label: Leave right now
right.after: This place isn't safe either. You walk out.

elif-asks.text: “How did you know? Is anything else going to happen today?”

left.label: Tell her what you saw
left.after: She doesn't laugh. She asks for your number.

right.label: “Just a feeling”
right.after: She doesn't believe you. She takes your number anyway.

road.text: The light is red and the road looks empty. Someone is running toward you from behind.

left.label: Wait and look back
left.after: The man hands you the keys you dropped. You are too scared to laugh.

right.label: Run across
right.after: A truck misses you by a hand. The horn rings in your ears.

elevator.text: Twelfth floor. The elevator creaks. The stairs were just mopped.

left.label: Take the stairs
left.after: Twelve floors. Your legs shake, but you made it.

right.label: Take the elevator
right.after: The doors close. The light flickers once. Nothing happens.

locked.text: Your keys are gone. A neighbour opens up: “The balconies touch. You can climb across.”

right.label: Wait for a locksmith
right.after: Two hours on the stairs. Boring, but you are alive.

left.label: Heat oil, fry an egg
left.after: You light the stove. The oil starts to warm.

right.label: Just drink water
right.after: Your stomach cramps, but the stove stays off.

mom.text: She saw the news. “Are you all right? Please pick up!”

left.label: Answer and calm her
left.after: You talk for twenty minutes. Both of you cry.

right.label: Turn off the stove first
right.after: Stove off. When you call back, her voice is shaking.

pan-fire.text: A burning smell. The pan is on fire and the flames reach for the hood.

right.label: Cover it, turn off the gas
right.after: The flame chokes out. Your hand is burned, but the flat survives.

sleep.text: You haven't slept since last night. Your eyes keep closing.

left.label: Sleep for a while
left.after: You dream about the bridge. It still helps.

right.label: Stay awake
right.after: You make coffee and watch the ceiling.

elif-news.text: “The other man who got off the bus is dead. In an elevator. Is that a coincidence? Should I come over?”
variants: “The other man who got off the bus is dead. In an elevator. Are we next? I'm coming over.”

left.label: “Come”
left.after: Half an hour later she is at your door.

witness.text: “This is the police. Cameras show you leaving the stop. We need your statement.”

left.label: “I'll come tomorrow”
left.after: The officer takes a note. Your palms are wet when you hang up.

right.label: Turn your phone off
right.after: The phone goes quiet. The silence is worse.

fuse.text: The power is out. The box is in the hallway and the floor is damp.

left.label: Flip the switch by hand
left.after: Elif holds up a torch. “Stop, that wire is bare!” You press the right switch.

right.label: Wait in the dark
right.after: An hour later the lights come back on their own.

railing.text: She is on the balcony, leaning on the railing. Was that railing always this loose?

left.label: “Come inside, now!”
left.after: She glares and steps in. A moment later the railing drops into the dark.

door.text: Someone knocks. Nobody in the peephole. The heavy wardrobe stands beside you.

left.label: Open it and look
left.after: Nobody. On the mat lies this morning's bus ticket.

road.title: The Horn
chain: You wanted to escape the sirens
You thought someone was chasing you
road.hint: At least the music was good.

stairs.title: The Wet Step
stairs.text: On the seventh floor your foot slipped. Empty air. That's all.
chain: You didn't wait for it to dry
stairs.hint: You had no time to dry your shoe. Hope you made it, wherever you were going.

balcony.title: The Next Balcony
balcony.text: The gap was wider than it looked.
chain: You didn't notice your keys were gone
balcony.hint: That man was bringing your keys. Good thing you outran him.

kitchen.title: A Glass of Water
kitchen.text: The moment water hit the oil, fire leapt to the ceiling.
chain: You heated oil for an egg
kitchen.hint: You don’t pour water on burning oil. You were the last to find out.

fuse.title: The Bare Wire
fuse.text: In the dark, you touched the wrong place.
chain: You didn't ask Elif to come
You saved nobody, so you were alone
fuse.hint: The lights would have come back in an hour. But who has an hour?

railing.title: The Railing
railing.text: You hugged her. The railing couldn't hold you both.
chain: You got through the night together

wardrobe.title: The Wardrobe
wardrobe.text: Guarding the door, you pulled the wardrobe down on yourself.
chain: You spent the whole day alone
You pulled a heavy wardrobe alone
wardrobe.hint: There was nobody at the door. The wardrobe got you anyway.

panic.title: The Cyclist
panic.text: You stopped in the middle of a street and couldn't walk on. You never saw the cyclist.
panic.hint: You escaped the bridge. A bicycle got you.

collapse.title: The Counter's Corner
collapse.text: In the kitchen your head spun, and the counter's corner was very close.
collapse.hint: You cheated death and skipped breakfast. Only one of those was smart.

alone.title: Nobody Called
alone.text: You fell. You shouted for hours. There was nobody left to call you.
alone.hint: You didn’t pick up. Eventually, they stopped calling.

together.title: Midnight
together.text: 00:00. You are both alive. Elif says nothing. Neither do you. Death missed two people today.
together.hint: You found the best ending. There’s always tomorrow, though.

survivor.title: Midnight
survivor.text: 00:00. You are alive. You saved nobody today, but you are here. Death got it wrong.
